jobs.occupation: Employer Branding & Internal Communications Specialist / Senior Specialist (m/f/d) (Employer-Branding-Manager/in)
jobs.description:

the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Job
Responsibilities Build Our Employer Brand Develop and implement
creative employer branding initiatives across channels such as
LinkedIn, our career website and employer review platforms. Create
compelling content, including copy, campaign concepts and ideas for
visual and video content. Bring employer branding campaigns from the
initial concept through to execution. Ensure our global employer brand
is reflected authentically in our local activities. Shape Internal
Communications Help build and develop our internal communication
channels, including digital platforms and employee newsletters.
Discover and share stories from across the organization that
strengthen our culture and foster engagement. Translate complex topics
into clear, engaging communication for employees. Support internal
events, town halls and culture initiatives that connect our growing
workforce. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with colleagues
across HR and international stakeholders to ensure consistent and
effective communication. Act as a bridge between global corporate
communication principles and local implementation. Partner with HR and
Talent Acquisition to create a seamless employee and candidate
experience. Profile To be successful in this role, you should bring:
Professional experience in Employer Branding or Internal
Communications. Strong copywriting and storytelling skills with the
ability to create engaging content for different audiences. Excellent
communication skills in German and English (written and spoken). A
hands-on mindset with the motivation to turn ideas into action and
deliver results. The ability to work effectively with international
stakeholders in a multicultural environment. It would be a plus if you
also have: Experience building internal communication channels (e.g.
intranet, newsletters, employee communication platforms). Experience
with social media, employer branding campaigns or digital content
creation. Experience in a growing, international or greenfield
environment. Why Join ESMC? Make a Visible Impact Your ideas won’t
stay on presentation slides –they’ll become part of the culture of
one of Europe’s most exciting semiconductor projects. Build
Something New Join a true greenfield project where you’ll help shape
our employer brand and internal communications from the very
beginning. Enjoy Creative Ownership Bring your own ideas to life while
working within an international environment that values initiative,
collaboration and continuous improvement. Experience the Best of Both
Worlds Benefit from the agility and team spirit of a growing local
organization, backed by the strength and stability of global
technology leaders. Grow With Us As ESMC continues to expand, you’ll
have the opportunity to grow your role, broaden your expertise and
help shape the future of our organization Additional contact details
ESMC recruiting team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits
with hiring criteria. Thanks!

jobs.occupation: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical Systems) (m/f/d) (Betriebstechniker/in)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical
Systems) (m/f/d) As Facilities Technician you are responsible for
operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of electrical systems for
all power up to and including 110kV including Site Substations,
Service Entry Sections, Electrical switchgear, Panelboards,
Transformers, cabling systems, metering circuits, diesel generators,
uninterruptable power supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU),
Remote Power Panel (RPP), and Static Transfer Switch (STS) as well as
motor connections, Motors and electrical controls. You play the
pivotal role to ensure standard operating procedures are followed
accurately and reliably to ensure our fab follows highest
environmental protection standards. By performing laboratory testing
and systematic verification and alignment of measurements from various
instruments, sensors, and equipment our fab can run smoothly thanks to
your work. Tasks Maintains a clean, orderly, and safe workplace,
follow all safety policies and procedures at all times and make
recommendations for continuous improvement of work method, safety,
materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site
performance indicators and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for
interruptions or incidents. Performs troubleshooting, emergency and
corrective maintenance and repair actions. Performs diagnostic to
determine root cause and corrective actions needed to maintain systems
operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.
Maintains log of gauge readings, shift throughput, and equipment
malfunctions. Patrols area to inspect equipment and record tank levels
and gauge readings. Ensures processing conditions and process output
are within regulatory limits and alerting management of discrepancies.
Perform standard and non-standard equipment maintenance, repairs and
modifications to ensure smooth operations inline with environmental
protection requirements. Profile Qualifications and Education:
Eligible to work in Germany and available for 3 months on-the-job
training in Taiwan. Technician or equivalent technical apprenticeship
education as electrician, in Mechatronics or a related field. Minimum
2–3 years of experience in a facilities, utilities, or electrical
related role. Qualified electrician to effectively detect and repair
defects in the operation of plant electrical equipment. Willingness to
work in a cleanroom environment with rotating shifts or on-call
duties. Deep interest in mechanical, chemical, and electrical
principles related to mechanical systems. Language Skills: Good
command of English with good command of German to communicate in our
international workplace. Professional Skills: Knowledge of industry
standards, codes and regulations, and the ability to apply to
maintenance operation of site Electrical systems. Functional level
knowledge of Electrical theory to troubleshoot and repair electrical
controls and electrical power distribution systems, complex procedures
pertinent to equipment and power distribution and wiring repair.
Operational knowledge of medium and high voltage cabling systems,
understanding the hazards associated with the specific class of system
voltage, and being able to mitigate these hazards through safe working
practices. Basic computer skills, ability to learn usage of standard
maintenance and process monitoring software. Able to read and
interpret technical manuals and process schematics. Capable of working
independently and cooperatively with other Technicians, Engineers, and
Managers with a strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy,
and problem-solving. Personal Attributes: Having strong values of
honesty, integrity and respect for others. We offer Each journey
starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will
provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future
of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential
to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international
startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the
experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced
semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample
opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation,
and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and
other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced
technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by
our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust
(ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive leadership and
passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our people vision:
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Additional
contact de

jobs.occupation: International Logistics Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Groß- und Außenhandel (Außenhandel))
jobs.description:
About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: International Logistics
Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) At ESMC, we are building a
state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in Dresden. As part of our
international Supply Chain organization, you will play a key role in
establishing efficient global logistics processes that ensure the
reliable movement of materials, equipment and goods across
international borders. This position offers the opportunity to shape
logistics processes from the ground up in an international greenfield
environment while working closely with colleagues, logistics providers
and customs authorities around the world. Tasks Manage international
import and export shipments for the Dresden fab and related locations.
Coordinate daily logistics operations together with freight forwarders
and logistics service providers. Support customs clearance activities
and ensure compliant import and export processes. Review
logistics-related invoices and payment processes within SAP. Monitor
logistics service providers against agreed KPIs and support continuous
performance improvements. Collaborate closely with internal
departments, suppliers, customs authorities and international
logistics partners. Support the implementation and harmonization of
global logistics processes and systems. Identify opportunities to
improve logistics, customs and global trade processes in a rapidly
growing manufacturing environment. Contribute to establishing scalable
logistics structures within our greenfield project. Profile Required:
Bachelor’s or Master´s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain
Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a
comparable qualification. Several years of professional experience
(approximately 7+ years) in international logistics, import/export,
customs or global trade. Strong knowledge of customs regulations and
international import/export processes. Practical experience
coordinating international shipments. Experience working with customs
brokers, freight forwarders and logistics providers. Strong
communication skills and experience working with international
stakeholders. Fluent German and good English skills. Nice to have:
Experience within semiconductor, electronics, automotive or other
manufacturing industries. Experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of export control regulations. Mandarin language skills. We
offer Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in
Europe. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues
across Europe, Taiwan and the US. Shape logistics processes instead of
maintaining existing structures. Participate in global projects and
cross-functional collaboration. International onboarding including
4–6 weeks of training in Taiwan and Arizona. Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting
team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring
criteria.

jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) - Start Date: 1 October 2026 (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Für unsere
zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und
engagierte/n: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) – Start Date: 1 October
2026 At ESMC, the Equipment Engineer supports the installation,
maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of advanced
semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom environment. As
part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation, the role focuses on ensuring
tool performance, improving uptime, reducing defects, and supporting
stable production. The position requires openness to scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty, includes an initial induction and
training period in Dresden of one month, followed by one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. If you are interested in advancing your
career in semiconductor manufacturing, learning from one of the
world’s leading semiconductor companies, and joining an
international and diverse team on a unique learning journey, apply now
with your English CV. Tasks 1. Maintain equipment performance in a
cleanroom environment to support stable, high-quality production. 2.
Handle on-duty tasks and perform fundamental alarm troubleshooting. 3.
Install and qualify new tool sets according to project plans and
schedules. 4. Identify root causes and solve critical equipment
issues. 5. Improve tool uptime and availability while driving defect
reduction. 6. Identify and pursue opportunities for hardware
capability enhancement. 7. Build defense and monitoring systems to
prevent equipment failures and performance loss. 8. Manage vendor
relationships and act as module liaison with facilities, vendors, and
manufacturing shift personnel. 9. Support scheduled night shifts,
evening shifts, weekend work, on-duty assignments, and on-call duties
as required in a 24/7 high-volume manufacturing environment. Profile

1. Legally eligible to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately
one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics,
electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics,
mechatronics, material engineering, or an equivalent field. 5.
Practical experience in a mechanical or equipment-related field. 6.
Understanding of technical documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge
of semiconductor manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with
good command of German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open
mindset. 10. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able
to perform physical work on tools in a cleanroom environment.
Important Candidate Information: Start Date: This role is planned to
commence on October 1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and
timeline preferences, January 1, 2027, can be considered as an
alternative start date. Onboarding and International Training: The
first month of your employment will be spent in Dresden. Following
this initial onboarding, training, and integration with your new team
members, you will travel to Taiwan for a one-year on-the-job training
and knowledge transfer program. Your training in Taiwan will involve
close collaboration with experienced TSMC engineering teams. You may
also receive additional training and support at TSMC’s
state-of-the-art Newcomer Training Center in Taichung. Training
Logistics: For employees requiring accommodation during the first
month in Dresden, and who reside more than 90 minutes away, ESMC will
organize appropriate temporary lodging. This provision does not apply
to employees who establish a residential address in Dresden (e.g., to
expedite work permit procedures away from their original place of
residence) or who terminate a personal lease contract in Dresden prior
to their planned departure to Taiwan. Furthermore, ESMC will organize
and provide air and ground transportation from Dresden to Taichung
(Taiwan) and back at the conclusion of the training. Accommodation in
Taiwan will be provided in one of TSMC’s modern and comfortable
company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a
unique opportunity to gain exposure to TSMC’s world-leading advanced
manufacturing practices and actively contribute to building ESMC from
the ground up. As a start-up organization, ESMC offers the opportunity
to play an active role in shaping the company’s culture, future
organization and ways of working. Candidates should be comfortable in
a dynamic environment where certain operational details such as
processes, documentation, shift structures, will continue to evolve
during the ramp-up phase. This role is ideal for individuals with a
strong growth mindset, a positive attitude, and a long-term
perspective. We offer Jede Reise beginnt mit dem ersten Schritt. Der

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales (m/w/d) (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
The chemical industry is one of the world's growth sectors with a
promising future. The TALKE Group is one of the leading specialist

Companies across Europe, the Gulf States, India, China, and the United

operationally, with a strong focus on customer retention, growth, and
innovation. As a member of our leadership team, you will actively
shape the future of chemical logistics, further develop our sales
organization, and set benchmarks in a dynamic market environment. Your
Key Responsibilities Strategy: Develop and implement long-term sales
strategies for existing customers and new business acquisition, with a
focus on innovation and emerging technologies. Customer Management:
Actively manage our customer portfolio, particularly strategic key
accounts, and establish a value-based customer management approach.
Team Leadership: Lead, motivate, and develop our sales teams (Key

focus on performance, professional growth, and our corporate values.
Contract & Pricing Management: Negotiate contracts and pricing

and compliance. Process Optimization: Continuously improve our sales

managing budgets and KPIs. Leadership: Proven success in leading and

Office) and data-driven decision-making. Languages: Business fluent
English (C1 level); additional foreign languages are an advantage.
Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, empathy, decisiveness,
and the ability to actively drive change. What We Offer Scope for
Impact: A strategic leadership role with direct reporting to the

locations across Europe and beyond. Innovation: An environment that
encourages digital solutions and fresh ideas to shape the next
generation of logistics. Values-Driven Culture: A working environment

Opportunities: Individual learning and development programs as well as
long-term career prospects in a growing market. Kontakt Kontakt: Frau

jobs.occupation: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Einkauf und Logistik)
jobs.description:

the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies

laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help

Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.occupation: Engineer - CTO (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join the dynamic Internal Consulting team at Boehringer Ingelheim! We're looking for innovative thinkers who are ready to shape our company's future.
As a Manager Consulting, you'll design, execute, and steer strategic initiatives within Boehringer Ingelheim. You'll independently coordinate project tasks, run data analyses, develop hypotheses and strategize solutions.
We value work-life balance, offering flexible work models and a location at the Headquarters in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main area.
This position is part time eligible with min. 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As Manager Consulting, you will support in the design, execution and steering of strategic initiatives across businesses, functions, therapeutic areas, and regions within Boehringer Ingelheim.
- You will independently drive work packages within projects, generating strategic insights to enable informed decisions of top-level leaders.
- With your experience, you will run data analyses, develop hypotheses, find possible strategic paths and create actionable solutions to advance the organization.
- Having the successful outcome always in mind, you will track the progress and strategic alignment of projects and initiatives, in close collaboration with our business partners.

Requirements

- Excellent master's degree in sciences, economics or engineering (PhD or MBA a plus)
- Several years' experience with top-tier management consultancy, preferably with a focus on Pharma
- Track record of working on diverse national and international strategic projects
- Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, with high attention to detail
- Great team player, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills
- C1 level English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
